info.name: Spotter Fuel Optimizer â€” Backend
info.description: Read-only backend checks. Start Django on port 8000 and run requests in order; the station list captures a valid station_id automatically. No credentials are included. Route examples use real US endpoints. Long routes require verified station coverage; a documented 422 is expected until enrichment provides reachable stops.

exec: pm.test("Database is ready", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("ok"); pm.expect(body.database).to.eql("ok"); });

item.name: List stations and capture an ID

exec: pm.test("Paginated stations have valid prices", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.count).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(body.results).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(body.results.length).to.be.at.most(5); body.results.forEach(function (station) { pm.expect(Number(station.median_price)).to.be.above(0); }); pm.collectionVariables.set("station_id", String(body.results[0].id)); });

pm.test("Detail matches selected station", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(String(body.id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("station_id")); pm.expect(body.source_id).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(body.location).to.have.property("status"); pm.expect(body.location).to.have.property("coordinates"); });

pm.test("Only Texas stations returned", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.results).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; body.results.forEach(function (station) { pm.expect(station.state).to.eql("TX"); }); });
pm.test("Invalid state returns HTTP 400", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

pm.test("Fuel plan geometry and accounting are valid", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.geometry.type).to.eql("LineString"); pm.expect(b.fuel_constraints_verified).to.eql(true); const initial=Number(b.initial_fuel_gallons), purchased=Number(b.fuel_purchased_gallons), consumed=Number(b.fuel_consumed_gallons), remaining=Number(b.remaining_fuel_gallons); pm.expect(Math.abs(initial+purchased-consumed-remaining)).to.be.below(0.000001); let cost=0; b.fuel_stops.forEach(function(s) { pm.expect(Number(s.departure_fuel_gallons)).to.be.at.most(50.000001); pm.expect(Number(s.arrival_fuel_gallons)).to.be.at.least(0); cost+=Number(s.cost); }); pm.expect(Math.abs(cost-Number(b.total_cost))).to.be.below(0.001); });

pm.test("Route succeeds or reports genuine station coverage failure", function () { pm.expect([200,422]).to.include(pm.response.code); if(pm.response.code===422) { pm.expect(["insufficient_station_coverage","verified_route_infeasible","station_access_not_verified","infeasible_route"]).to.include(pm.response.json().error.code); } });

if(pm.response.code===200) { pm.test("Fuel plan geometry and accounting are valid", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.geometry.type).to.eql("LineString"); pm.expect(b.fuel_constraints_verified).to.eql(true); const initial=Number(b.initial_fuel_gallons), purchased=Number(b.fuel_purchased_gallons), consumed=Number(b.fuel_consumed_gallons), remaining=Number(b.remaining_fuel_gallons); pm.expect(Math.abs(initial+purchased-consumed-remaining)).to.be.below(0.000001); let cost=0; b.fuel_stops.forEach(function(s) { pm.expect(Number(s.departure_fuel_gallons)).to.be.at.most(50.000001); pm.expect(Number(s.arrival_fuel_gallons)).to.be.at.least(0); cost+=Number(s.cost); }); pm.expect(Math.abs(cost-Number(b.total_cost))).to.be.below(0.001); }); }
